responsibility: Implements evaluation and support logic for D compile-time conditions and static foreach metadata. It resolves `debug`, `version`, and `static if` inclusion decisions against module and global identifier/level sets, manages predefined and reserved version identifiers, lowers some static-foreach aggregates such as arrays into tuple form for CTFE-based expansion, and contains helper transformations used when conditional declarations or statements are semantically selected.
same_name_distinction: Provides the runtime semantic evaluation of compile-time conditions and static-foreach preparation, such as deciding `debug`/`version`/`static if` inclusion and handling reserved version identifiers, whereas `cond.h` only defines the condition and static-foreach data structures and their APIs.
